name: SwaggerHub
description: SwaggerHub is SmartBear's platform for API design, documentation, testing, and governance, giving teams a centralized catalog and visual editor for building OpenAPI- and AsyncAPI-based API documentation.
best_for: Development teams, QA professionals, and product managers building APIs for both human and AI-agent consumption; used by enterprises including CVS, Salesforce, and Volvo.
features: AI-assisted API generation with intelligent design suggestions
Studio visual, code-optional editor for cross-functional API design
Centralized API catalog acting as a single source of truth
Contract testing that catches breaking changes during development
Automated mock server generation for testing without manual setup
Auto-generated API documentation portal with search and filtering
Low-code functional testing integrated with CI/CD pipelines
Explore feature for live API testing across REST and Kafka

alternatives.description: A developer-friendly API documentation platform combining a visual editor with AI-powered tools.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a polished, developer-facing API reference site.
